summary: The owning V2 plans distinguish functional adoption from comparative efficiency claims. V2-DIAG-01.4 still requires coherent publication and selected installed ordinary/native receiver behavior; observations from necessary attempts suffice for disposition, while a separate comparison window is conditional on a quantified benefit claim. V2-CTX-01.5 requires an admitted integrated operation/restart, original reservations and no duplicate effects before .6 adopts the qualified route with rollback; economics may remain inconclusive. V2-EFF-01.5 retains finite held-out calibration, truthful numeric/source references and private-or-disabled uncalibrated model claims; .6 still requires coherent publication, installed real-item assessment/projection/browser behavior, correction and rollback. A net-value comparison is conditional on claiming benefit. These scope decisions create no new cohort, weaken no required CI/security/privacy/native/credential/release/installed gate, and do not count source delivery as installed use.
title: Functional process adoption does not await comparative benefit
